name: Temple University viral vector core: AKTA pure L FPLC (NIH S10; 2016)
brief: A viral vector core replaces a decade-old, discontinued FPLC with a new workhorse chromatography system to purify recombinant AAV in larger batches for large-animal studies.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for one FPLC; options and any institutional match are not stated.

notes: Out-of-sample: found after the cost model was frozen at commit 02d7678 and scored blind against it (results in docs/validation.md). Later model or catalog changes do not count as out-of-sample for this case. price_basis=configured, from the wording of a grant to buy a working FPLC instrument (no bare-unit pricing stated). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10OD021583-01, award_amount 52599, project title "AKTA Pure L"; https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/9075312). Quote: "The primary purpose of this proposal is to fund the purchase of a General Electric AKTA pure fast protein liquid chromatography (FPLC) instrument." Proxy match: bought AKTA pure (title: pure L, single pump) vs catalog cytiva_akta_pure_25; 2016 vendor was GE Healthcare, not Cytiva.

equipment.rationale: Closest catalog model to the bought model (proxy).
